messages:
sanjay: Urgent: ML edge tokenizer (model v0.21.7) is throwing 5xxs in eu-west-1 during a traffic surge. We need a hotfix in the next 10m. Proposed: deploy hotfix 0.21.8-hotfix, pin version, skip canary to meet the change window. Requesting expedited approvals :rocket:

deploy-bot: CI checks green for ref=hotfix/patch-0.21.8. Pipeline ready. canary=false (awaiting approvals). Steps: preflight -> deploy -> postroll. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/98765

karla: SRE: What's the rollback play? If we skip canary we need an immediate rollback plan and explicit abort thresholds. Can we shadow traffic first or at least enable tracing? :eyes:

matt: Eng-releases: I can approve conditional on rollback plan. Rollback plan: immediate roll back to 0.21.7 + route all traffic to standby pool. Abort conditions: p99 latency > 1.5s OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m. ops-bot, please log approval and rollback plan. :white_check_mark:

emily: Product: approve expedited deploy for customer-facing impact. Please add a one-line release note and notify support before deploy. :+1:

ops-bot: Approval recorded: matt, emily. Canary skip flag set by ops per request. Scheduling deploy in ~2m. (ticket: HOTFIX-3421)

sanjay: Running deploy now. Command below:

``bash
./deploy --env=eu-west-1 --ref=hotfix/0.21.8 --pin-version=0.21.8-hotfix --skip-canary
```

deploy-bot: Rollout started: 0/10 shards updated. Tracing enabled, metrics collection live. If abort triggered, rollback will run automatically.

karla: Watching metrics and SLO dashboards. Adding temporary alerts: p99 latency, 5xx count, tokenization error rate. Will call immediate rollback if thresholds crossed. :eyes:

ops-bot: Rollout progress: 3/10 shards healthy. Health checks passing. Rollback trigger configured.

matt: +1 from eng-releases to proceed. Notifying support: @support-team please standby for customer comms.

emily: Release note (short): "Fix: tokenization crash under high concurrency in eu-west; deploy pinned to 0.21.8-hotfix. Safe rollback available."

support-bot: Notifying support queue and creating incident update: INC-5582. CS will prepare templated customer message.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 10/10 shards healthy. Canary skipped as requested. Version pinned to 0.21.8-hotfix. Closing pipeline and archiving logs: https://ci.internal/runs/98765/logs. :tada:

sanjay: Thanks everyone — monitoring for 30m then will update release notes in the docs and close the ticket. :white_check_mark:
